landing.headline: Mek ɔl avɛst tɔn mɔni fɔ tumara
landing.body: AgriLink de jɔyn fama, ko-op, baya ɛn lɔn ɔfis dɛn. Sɛl tɔn sev, rɛkɔd tɔn lɔn — pan ɛni fon.
landing.featureRegisterBody: Rejista fama dɛn na fil, ivin if nɛtwɔk nɔ de.
landing.featurePayBody: Gɛt yu mɔni strɛt na Orange Money, Afrimoney ɔ QMoney.
landing.featureCreditBody: Yu rɛkɔd ɛn yu sev de bil yu AgriLink skɔ.
landing.title: Ɛni lɛon, usai i fɔ go.
landing.lead: We baya pe fɔ fama in krɔp, AgriLink de sheb di mɔni wan tɛm: di lɔn pe, di sev grɔ, di ko-op gɛt in dyuz, ɛn di fama gɛt di rɛst — strɛt na mobayl mɔni.
landing.heroCaption: Aminata sɛl 1,000 kg rɛs. Le 4,000 kam.
landing.how1: Di ko-op wej di krɔp ɛn rayt di sɛl.
landing.how2: Di baya pe wan tɛm, wit mobayl mɔni.
landing.how3: AgriLink sheb di pemɛnt di tɛm we i kam.
landing.how4: Di fama gɛt SMS we sho usai ɛni lɛon go.
landing.how5: Gud sɛl de bil Fam Paspɔt we de opin lɔn fɔ input.
landing.whoTitle: Wi mek am fɔ ɔlman na di chen
landing.whoFarmerBody: Si ɛni pemɛnt, sev na avɛst tɛm, ɛn lɛnt sid ɛn fɛtilayza wit dɛn yon rɛkɔd — pan ɛni fon, ivin USSD.
landing.whoCoopBody: Rayt di bay ivin we nɛtwɔk nɔ de, pe ɔl di mɛmba dɛn wan tɛm, gɛt dyuz we yu nɔ de rɔn afta kach.
landing.whoLenderBody: Gi lɔn fɔ input as vawcha, ɛn gɛt yu mɔni bak ɔtomatik frɔm di nɛks avɛst sɛl.
landing.whoDealerBody: Tek vawcha kod, gi di input, ɛn gɛt yu mɔni na mobayl mɔni di sem de.
landing.foot: Na prototayp fɔ di Sierra Leone FinTech Innovation Challenge 2026. Na dɛmo data nɔmɔ.
landing.demoBody: Pik wan pɔsin. Wan klik go sayn yu in — yu nɔ nid fon ɔ kod. Fala dɛn wan bay wan, 1 to 5.
